verdict: passed: 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor, 0 nit over all 22 keys. F-r3-1 is resolved at BOTH readers of the shared keys: the four filter segments read 'Tout | Créé | Installé | Intégré' in the real render with no truncation, and the per-agent slot (roster SourceChip + detail AgentMeta) reads the masculine singular 'Intégré', 'Créé', 'Installé' under one agent each. F-r3-2 is resolved: the sr-only legend now names 'les agents'.

resolved_findings.verification: Both readers checked in code and in the translator's real-render frames. (a) Filter slot: agents-page.tsx:140-145 maps SCOPE_LABEL keys, :760-770 renders {t(SCOPE_LABEL[value])} into aria-pressed buttons; measured scopeButtons = [Tout, Créé, Installé, Intégré] with truncatedCount 0, every segment scrollWidth == clientWidth == 62 and minContentSum 199.59 px inside buttonBoxSum 246 px. (b) Per-agent slot: detail-parts.tsx:258-266 sourceLabel() returns the same three keys to SourceChip (detail-parts.tsx:231) and AgentMeta (agent-detail.tsx:171); frames show 'Créé' on aa-custom, 'Installé' on Aida and 'Intégré' on each built-in row, and the detail meta lines read 'Intégré' (coder), 'Créé' (aa-custom), 'Installé · Proactif · Delegates' (Aida), each with pluralHits []. A masculine singular adjective is the only form that is grammatical in BOTH slots; 'Tout' is the shipped invariable 'All'.
resolved_findings.accepted_note: Considered and rejected: 'Tous' as the All label (it would put a plural pronoun beside three singular class labels in one row, and 'Tout' already ships for this sense in ui.common.actions.find_replace_widget.all). Raised as no finding: a bare masculine singular is a normal French class label and the row reads natively.

resolved_findings.verification: Value is now 'Afficher les agents selon leur propriétaire'. The fieldset is rendered only when !teamMode (agents-page.tsx:743-746, the scope control filters agents alone), so naming 'agents' is the accurate noun and matches the page's visible vocabulary ('Agents et équipes', 'Rechercher des agents', 'Aucun agent…'). sr-only, so no fit change; measured scopeLegend equals the audited value.
